# p0_aws_lambda_notifier (Resource)

An AWS Lambda notifier. P0 invokes the function when a pre-approval is created and when it expires.

**Prerequisite:** P0 must be able to invoke the function, through a `p0_aws_function_caller` resource. Set `function_caller` to that resource's `id`, so that Terraform creates this notifier after it.

For the full install steps, see [AWS Lambda notifier](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/notifier-integrations/custom-notifiers/aws-lambda-notifier).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Lambda function that P0 invokes with each notification event.
resource "aws_iam_role" "notifier" {
  name = "p0-notifier"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect    = "Allow"
      Action    = "sts:AssumeRole"
      Principal = { Service = "lambda.amazonaws.com" }
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "notifier" {
  function_name = "p0-notifier"
  role          = aws_iam_role.notifier.arn
  runtime       = "nodejs22.x"
  handler       = "index.handler"
  filename      = "notifier.zip"
}

# The role P0 assumes to invoke the function, with permission to invoke it.
resource "p0_aws_function_caller_staged" "notifier" {
  id = aws_lambda_function.notifier.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "p0_function_caller" {
  name               = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.role.name
  assume_role_policy = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.role.trust_policy
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "p0_function_caller" {
  name   = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.role.inline_policy_name
  role   = aws_iam_role.p0_function_caller.name
  policy = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.role.inline_policy
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "p0_read_role" {
  name   = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.role.reader_policy_name
  role   = aws_iam_role.p0_function_caller.name
  policy = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.role.reader_policy
}

resource "p0_aws_function_caller" "notifier" {
  id = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.notifier.id
  depends_on = [
    aws_iam_role_policy.p0_function_caller,
    aws_iam_role_policy.p0_read_role,
  ]
}

# The notifier. Referencing the function caller's id creates it after the
# function caller is installed.
resource "p0_aws_lambda_notifier" "example" {
  id              = "p0-notifier"
  function_caller = p0_aws_function_caller.notifier.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_caller` (String) The ARN of the Lambda function to invoke, the `id` of an installed `p0_aws_function_caller`
- `id` (String) The name P0 gives the notifier. P0 sends it to the function as the event's `id`.

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed
